High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Sanjay Kumar Sharma - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Sonal Gupta - Additional A.G. for the respondent /

Heard on I.A. No.2970 of 2025 which is second (repeat) application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.
for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant Shahrukh S/o Babu.

02. The appellant has been convicted under Section 366 and 376(2)
(m) of Ipc and sentenced to undergo 5 years' R.I. with fine of Rs.5,000/- and L.I. with fine of
Rs.5,000/- respectively with default stipulation.

03. Learned counsel appearing for respondent / State has opposed the present application by
submitting that the Prosecutrix was aged about 60 years at the time of incident and the present
appellant was 26 years old and he committed rape upon her in the evening on 27.10.2017 thus, the
present application deserves to be dismissed.
04.
The case of the present appellant is that the Prosecutrix made different statement before PW/7.
She did not name the appellant and there was an enmity between the present appellant and father and family members of the Prosecutrix thus, he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

She further submits that the trial Court has recorded the conviction of the applicant under Section 376(2)(m) of IPC, whereas the said provision came into existence after the date date of incident i.e.
27.10.2017.
Had the offence 2 CRA-6034-2019 been committed under Section 376 of IPC the minimum sentence was 7 years and maximum would be extended upto 10 years.

In the present case,
the applicant has already undergone 7 and a half years.

05. Having heard the counsel for parties and keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case and that the appellant has completed seven and a half years in custody, this appeal is of the year 2019 and hearing of the same is likely to take a considerable time as presently the appeals of the years 2004-05 are being taken up for hearing, however, without commenting upon the merits of the case, we deem it appropriate to allow the present application.

06. It is ordered that the jail sentence imposed upon this appellant Shahrukh S/o Babu shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he is directed to be released on bail on he Shahrukh Kha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186402427/

07. Accordingly, I.A. No.2970 of 2025 for suspension of sentence is allowed and disposed of.
